consent.title: Your consent
consent.intro: A calorie counter can't count without knowing what you eat and weigh. That is health data, and we may only process it with your explicit consent.
consent.declineNote: If you don't consent, you can't use Hello Cal. You can log out or ask for your account to be deleted via the Help center.

settings.title: Settings

support.title: Support
support.intro: Because we take your privacy seriously, Hello Cal Support does not have access to your personal data or account by default. You decide which data Support may temporarily view.
support.description: Below you can choose which data we may view and specify the period during which it may be accessed.
support.dateRequired: Select both a start and end date.
support.invalidDateRange: The start date cannot be after the end date.
support.untilInPast: The end date cannot be before today.
support.loadError: The support permission could not be loaded.
support.saveError: The support permission could not be saved.
support.contactRequired: Fill in both subject and message.
support.contactError: The message could not be sent. Please try again.
support.contactSent: Thanks, we have received your request. Your case number is {caseCode}.

settings.regionDescription: Prioritizes product search by your country's barcodes.
settings.showAllergensDescription: Show an allergen line on foods when data is available.
settings.showExtendedNutritionDescription: At the bottom of each product page you can see the extended nutrition values (saturated/unsaturated/trans fat, cholesterol, sodium, potassium, fibre, sugar, vitamin A and C, calcium and iron). The section is open by default and shown when data exists.
settings.showAdditivesDescription: Shows the product's E-numbers (additives) on the product page. Tap an E-number to read what it is and what research says.
settings.showToxinsDescription: Shows known unwanted substances on the product page based on the ingredient list — e.g. solanine in potatoes, coumarin in cinnamon and mercury in tuna. Advice for pregnant, breastfeeding and those trying to conceive is shown first. Sources: Danish Veterinary and Food Administration and EFSA.
settings.thirdPartyDisclaimer: We fetch data from third parties and take no responsibility for missing data.
settings.languageDescription: Choose which language the app is shown in.
settings.setupProgressHint: Complete weight calibration to finish setup.
settings.inviteFriendDescription: And get a free month each
settings.inviteShareText: Try Hello Cal with me — then we both get a free month!
settings.displayHelpTip: Here you decide how the front page, the calendar and warnings look on this device.
settings.showTooltipsDescription: Shows a small help text under the various settings and windows.
settings.showStartupTipsDescription: Shows a short full-screen tip when you open the app, about features you have not used yet.

privacy.title: Your data is yours
privacy.body: Hello Cal stores the information you record yourself — such as meals, weight, goals and health data — so we can calculate your intake and show your results. We never sell your data, and you can view, export or have it deleted at any time.

calendarViewSettings.title: Calendar view
calendarViewSettings.intro: Choose which view the calendar opens in by default.

displaySettings.title: Recommended limits
displaySettings.warnOnRecommendedLimits: Highlight values above/below the recommended normal range
displaySettings.warnOnRecommendedLimitsDescription: Shows a 1 px dark-red border around statistic cards when a documented recommendation for your region and profile is exceeded. Missing data is never flagged.
displaySettings.autoExpandUncertaintyDescription: A green ~ always appears in front of values we have estimated because the manufacturer does not state them. Turn this on to show the grey uncertainty line under the value without tapping.

menstrualCycleSettings.intro: Log your menstrual cycle and get it as an option in the add menu.
menstrualCycleSettings.toggleDescription: Adds "Period" to the add menu so you can log when your cycle starts.

frontPageSettings.intro: Choose which fields should appear in the wheel on the front page. The top field always shows a list of every add-element.
frontPageSettings.sideHint: The number slider always shows on the opposite side: {side}.
frontPageSettings.maxReachedHint: Remove a field to add another one.
frontPageSettings.statsIntro: Choose which numbers can appear in the front page's number slider. If the list gets long, just scroll.

redeemPage.title: Redeem points
redeemPage.giftFriend: Give a friend a free month of Serious access!

freePlan.title: Free
freePlan.description: Access to everything in Hello Cal except Hello Doc. Only the last 30 days of history are shown — older data is kept and comes back if you go Serious.

seriousPlan.title: Serious
seriousPlan.description: Full history with no 30-day limit, plus access to Hello Doc.
seriousPlan.upgradeUnavailable: Payment isn't connected yet — use a gift code or redeem points to go Serious until a payment provider is in place.
seriousPlan.withdrawalConsent: I want the subscription to start right away, and I understand that if I withdraw within 14 days, I will only be refunded for the part of the period I haven't used.

subscription.retentionNote: Data older than 30 days is never deleted — it's kept and shown again as soon as you go Serious.

profileSleep.shiftWorkHint: Open a day in the calendar to log work hours and any sleep override for that day. The data is used in the calendar's sleep visualization.

weightCalibration.title: Weight calibration
weightCalibration.intro: Weigh yourself at different times and under different conditions — this gives you a sense of your fluctuation throughout the day, without having to weigh yourself naked every time.

bodyMeasurements.title: Body measurements
bodyMeasurements.intro: Log your body measurements alongside your weight — they often change before the scale does, giving a fuller picture of your body over time.

account.newsletterIntro: Hello Cal does not know your email. To receive newsletters, sign up separately — the signup is not linked to your account.
account.newsletterSent: Check your email to confirm the signup.
account.pushOnlyHint: Hello Cal does not know your email, so messages are only sent as push.
account.networkError: Something went wrong — check your connection and try again
account.loginIntro: Hello Cal uses passkeys instead of passwords. You log in with Face ID, fingerprint or your device PIN.
account.loginPrivacy: Your data is encrypted on your device. Neither we nor anyone else can read it.
account.loginFailed: Could not log in with passkey
account.noPasskeySupport: Your browser does not support passkeys. Update your browser or use another device.
account.signupIntro: Enter your email. We will send you a link to create your account.
account.signupEmailNote: We do not store your email address — only an unrecognisable fingerprint of it, so you can recover access later.
account.checkMailBody: If the address is valid, we have sent you a link. It works for 30 minutes.
account.confirmIntro: Your device will now create a passkey for Hello Cal. It also unlocks your encrypted vault.
account.linkMissing: The link is invalid or has expired. Start over.
account.recoveryFileIntro: If you lose all your devices, this file is the only way back to your data. Keep it somewhere safe, e.g. in your email or a cloud folder.
account.recoveryFileWarning: Without the file, neither you nor we can open your data again.
account.recoveryFileSplit: The file only works together with the Hello Cal half, which we only release after you have confirmed your identity with support.
account.passkeyDeviceOnly: Your browser cannot use the passkey to unlock your data on other devices. The key is only stored on this device — keep the recovery file safe.
account.recoverIntro: Enter the email you created the account with. We will send you a link.
account.recoverChooseTitle: How do you want to recover?
account.haveFileNote: You open a case. Once support has confirmed your identity, you can open your data again.
account.fileInvalid: This is not a valid Hello Cal recovery file
account.noFile: I have neither a device nor the file
account.noFileNote: You can start over with an empty account. Your old data can never be opened again — not even by us.
account.startOver: Start over with an empty account
account.startOverConfirm: Are you sure? Your old data will never be accessible again.
account.caseInstructions: Contact Hello Cal support with the case number and your email. We confirm it is you and approve the case.
account.approvedIntro: The case is approved. Choose your recovery file again and create a new passkey.
account.lockedTitle: Your data is locked on this device
account.lockedBody: You are logged in, but the key to your data is not on this device. Use recovery to unlock it.
account.deleteAccountConfirm: Are you sure? Your data is deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.
